description: Agent Triage: submit the intake records an agent captured for incoming work, with the arrival log behind them: each item with its id, where it came in (an inbox, a form, chat, an API or a monitor), when it arrived, who sent it or asked for it, what it is about, when the intake record was complete and when sorting began, the first severity, priority or route set on it; and optionally each arrival as the source systems logged it, with its id, its source and when it arrived. The signed report gives every intake record with the parts it is missing, whether it was sorted before it was complete and its status as complete, incomplete, sorted_early or unconfirmed, every arrival with its status as captured or uncaptured, and counts the items, the arrivals, the arrivals left uncaptured and the items sorted early, and names intake left loose: arrivals with no intake record and items sorted before their intake record was complete; then records with no source, no arrival time, no requester or no subject, with the fix for each. This reads incoming work captured before any sorting begins: promises captured from messages are wever_commitment-capture-check, and the records of handoffs a system made are wever_handoff-record-check. Verdict intake_loose, intake_partial, intake_missing or intake_complete. POST /api/triage-intake-check. Reads only the recorded queue items and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no item is captured, ranked, routed, escalated or closed and no queue is changed. Agent Triage reads how an agent sorts incoming work, from the item captured at intake to the disposition it ends with: it is not multi-agent coordination (how a group of agents organizes shared work, with its own escalation path, the wever_coordination checks; triage escalation is a single queue item breaching its threshold and moving up a tier, with its context attached), not the promises an agent has made (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; triage decides handling order and routing before any promise exists), not delegation (handing work off with authority, the wever_delegation checks; triage assigns incoming items to queues and owners, a sorting decision rather than a delegation) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the triage checks read a queue of items over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-triage-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-triage/.
